description: This file defines a comprehensive serialization framework in C#, including classes for serializing and deserializing values, type-specific serializers, object serializers, and serializer sessions. It provides methods for serializing data to arrays, streams, and various buffer types, supporting both statically typed and dynamically typed scenarios.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: A class providing methods for serializing and deserializing data of any type, supporting various buffer and stream types, with runtime type checking.

classes.name: Serializer<T>
classes.description: A class for serializing and deserializing specific value types, with support for various buffer and stream types, leveraging codecs.

classes.name: ValueSerializer<T>
classes.description: A class for serializing and deserializing value types with potentially generated code, supporting various buffer and stream types.

classes.name: ObjectSerializer
classes.description: A class enabling serialization and deserialization of objects with types that are not known at compile time.

methods.name: SerializeToArray
methods.description: Serializes a value into a new byte array.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Various overloads to deserialize data from streams, buffers, and memory into a value of type T.
